enrichment method: we performed RNA pulldown assays using biotinylated probe targeting circNFKB1 in HCs cell lysates and analyzed associated protein(s) by mass spectrometry analysis
fractionation method: The pulldown proteins were separated using SDS-PAGE followed by silver staining using Pierce Silver Stain for Mass Spectrometry (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: analyzed associated protein(s) by mass spectrometry analysis
